SMARTMURTI AI PRIVATE LIMITED

COMPANY OVERVIEW
Smart Pandit is a live spiritual guidance platform
designed for Hindu NRI families across the US, UK,
Canada, and Europe. It enables families to quickly
access trusted pandits for urgent rituals,
consultations, and important life events, while also
allowing family members across different countries
to participate together in the same live puja or hawan
session. The platform focuses on preserving ritual
authenticity, enabling multilingual guidance, and
strengthening family connection through shared
spiritual experiences. By combining real-time human
guidance with supporting AI-driven infrastructure for
coordination, reminders, and accessibility, Smart
Pandit ensures convenience without compromising
trust, tradition, or continuity.
